name: Classic
note: The default cue, drawn procedurally by CueTextures.classic() (maple shaft, rosewood forearm, black Irish-linen wrap, polished silver joint and rings, glossy black sleeve, rubber bumper, blue chalky tip, white ferrule). Colours are Catalog.luau's Classic look.
default_note: Designer, 2026-09-30: Classic is labelled Common (one of the plan's 8 Commons) but stays the free default cue: everyone owns it, it never drops from a case, it is not tradable or sellable.
